steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: How come you didn't save me?

A blown-up hospital, calls for help amid a cloud of smoke, helpless doctors and nurses... You're back there. The puny maiden is standing before you, her body pockmarked with new bullet holes, on top of old bruises from years of torture.

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: You said you could suppress Mania... You said...

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: You said... you... would help me...
Jet-black spikes poke out of her cracked skin as she totters toward you. Each step she takes is accompanied by a cracking sound.

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: But why... you...
She falls down before you. Her tattered body is engulfed in a black miasma.
Because he can't save anyone.
Two shadowy forms clad in white walk past you. One of them bends over to pick up the girl covered in contamination.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: So many people died because of him, but it has no effect on him whatsoever. And he's trying to be our savior. How brazen!
steps.female_content: So many people died because of her, but it has no effect on her whatsoever. And she's trying to be our savior. How brazen!

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: He's no different than Ted. He holds dear the power in his hands, despite knowing it is evil. He even glorifies what he's doing as an honorable <color=#fb9259>fight</color>.
steps.female_content: She's no different than Ted. She holds dear the power in his hands, despite knowing it is evil. She even glorifies what she's doing as an honorable <color=#fb9259>fight</color>.

steps.content: A machete comes at you.

steps.speaker: Ninety-nine
steps.content: Give Hella back to me!

steps.speaker: Ninety-nine
steps.content: You said you would protect her. Then what? She's been protecting you all the time!

steps.speaker: Ninety-nine
steps.content: You're useless. You can protect no one! Loosen the Goddamn shackles, and <size=44>give her back to me!!</size>
The machete lands on you here and there, but it leaves no mark. The furious phantom runs through your body and reappears as a girl, whose hand takes hold of you.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Where is my commander...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: And my brother... where is he?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: You're so weak... so useless... How come only you came back...? Why?
The creator of the illusory realm keeps conjuring up phantoms of the victims. Amid all the curses and vengefulness, a Mania-studded right hand alights on your shoulder.
She looks up, surrounded by a black miasma, marks of a Corpseborne giving off an eerie purple light.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Cheer up! This is a heart-warming reunion. Don't you have a lot to talk to me?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Let's take about this blasted negotiation you brokered. I trusted you, and look where it got the Legion.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Don't pull these dirty tricks on me. It's the Corpus I'm looking for.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's the Corpus that I'm looking for. My enemy is the Black Ring. I'm here to fight, not to reflect on the things I did.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Huh, the Corpus, what if you find it? What makes you think that you can take on the Black Ring?!

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You pulled it off last time only because I let you connect with me through the shackles. You just got lucky.
She sneers, her carbonized skin flaking off as her body moves.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You would've died in the last Black Ring. You didn't have the power to defeat us. You're nothing without Sinners.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Fight? What difference does your fighting make?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: The sheriffs are still b***t, and Syndicate is still hell. What can you do about them with you and your shackles?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You're not seriously thinking of yourself as a savior, are you? You don't even have the slightest connection with this city!

The black energy of contamination is creeping up on Phantom Zoya. She doesn't resist it. Instead, she stands still. The scene of her going deranged unfolds before your eyes. You know it's just a mirage, but it's still shocking to behold.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: ...You want me to stay here too?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Mania comes from Black Rings, we all come from Black Rings. Stay here. Nothing wrong with that.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Meaningless fighting brings nothing but loss of lives. It's time to end it. Now is the right time.
She extends her hand. You hesitate, then take it.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Aaahhh...!!
The scarlet light chases away the mist almost entirely. Energy floods into your shackles, and they pierce and shatter Phantom Zoya's body.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: You... you tricked me...! I asked you to stay, and you tricked me!!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I trust only what I sense through my shackles. And I sense that the persons connected with me through the shackles are not here.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Enough with this illusory realm. Get out of here with me!

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Let go of me...!!
The illusory realm crumbles into dust. Vaguely, you feel someone knocking on your head, then you hear the familiar, soothing voices.

steps.speaker: Hella & Hecate
steps.content:
Wake up, you dumbass! 
Chief!
